name: connect-profisee-to-profisee-target-baseline-create
description: What: Back up the Profisee to Profisee target database as its Connect baseline (profisee_ConnectTarget_<CrewChief box>_<version code>.bak, overwritten): the 50 Dba domains with their rows and an empty PDataProfiseeToProfiseeImport. Run once after connect-model-profisee-to-profisee-target-build (part of connect-profisee-to-profisee-bootstrap). Why: A building block of the Connect pack; a test, setup or schedule workload runs it so its steps exist once. When: Never run directly once the pack is tested; its parents run it. Running it alone is safe only when its own Needs are met. Needs: reference values: connect/databases:ProfiseeToProfiseeDatabaseName, connect/instances:ProfiseeToProfiseeInstanceName, connect/machines:ProfiseeToProfiseeDatabaseServerName, connect/machines:ProfiseeToProfiseeServerName. Success: Every step Succeeded or Skipped. If it fails: Run connect-preflight first; then open the first failed step, whose If it fails text names what to check.

inline.description: What: Back up {{ProfiseeDatabaseName}} on {{DatabaseServerName}} to {{BackupFileName}} (overwrites the previous target baseline). Why: Backs up or restores the database so every run starts from the same known state (BackupDatabase). Success: SQL Server finishes the BackupDatabase of the database with the named file in its default backup folder. If it fails: Check the backup file exists in the SQL Server default backup folder of the database server, the disk has room, and the CrewChief account is sysadmin there.

inputs.name: ProfiseeToProfiseeDatabaseName
inputs.description: Profisee database name on the Profisee-to-Profisee target. Passed by the test that runs this one: connect reference data, or the CRUD lab set of a TestAutoManager round.

inputs.name: ProfiseeToProfiseeDatabaseServerName
inputs.description: SQL Server of the Profisee-to-Profisee target. Passed by the test that runs this one: connect reference data, or the CRUD lab set of a TestAutoManager round.

inputs.name: ProfiseeToProfiseeInstanceName
inputs.description: Profisee instance name on the Profisee-to-Profisee target. Passed by the test that runs this one: connect reference data, or the CRUD lab set of a TestAutoManager round.

inputs.name: ProfiseeToProfiseeServerName
inputs.description: Profisee-to-Profisee target application server (short name). Passed by the test that runs this one: connect reference data, or the CRUD lab set of a TestAutoManager round.

inputs.name: ProfiseeVersionCode
inputs.description: TestAuto version code (data.tProfiseeVersion) the runs are recorded under; the automation tags, run profile codes and backup names carry it. Passed by the test that runs this one (connect/environment:ProfiseeVersionCode, or the lane's version).
